resources.string: จัดการคิวชำระเงินจาก QR Code อย่างเป็นระบบ
Review, verify and confirm PromptPay QR payments one at a time. Import a folder of QR images, work through the queue, and keep the final confirmation in your own banking app.
Folder selection via the Android Storage Access Framework arrives in V0.2 — not implemented yet.
Image import is planned for V0.2 and is not implemented in this build.
ยังไม่มี QR ในคิว
Imported QR images will appear here with their amount, recipient and status. No sample or demo payments are ever mixed with real data.
You stay in control of every payment

QR Payment Queue prepares, organizes and hands off payment information. It never enters PINs or OTPs, never touches biometric prompts or bank security screens, and never marks a payment as paid on its own.
Queue states: DISCOVERED → DECODED → VALIDATED → READY → SUBMITTED → WAITING_CONFIRMATION → SUCCESS → RECONCILED / PAID
